item.title: Features on IDI iTunes Now
item.description: Isuma’s exhibition in cyberspace presents a collection of Isuma and other indigenous-language films, including Atanarjuat The Fast Runner (Cannes Camera d’Or 2001); The Journals of Knud Rasmussen (opening film at 2006 Toronto International Film Festival); Before Tomorrow (by Igloolik’s Arnait women’s collective); Edge of the Knife, the world’s first feature film in the Haida language; and One Day in the Life of Noah Piugattuk. item.title: One day in the life of Noah Piugattuk
item.description: One Day in the Life of Noah Piugattuk compresses Piugattuk’s 96-year lifetime into a dramatized feature film portrait of one day in that life, a 24-hour day when the sun never sets, out hunting seals on the spring sea ice in May 1961, in the Igloolik region of north Baffin Island.

item.title: The Isuma Book
item.description: The Isuma Book is an iterative online publication. New content is released each month from May to November during the period of the 58th Biennale di Venezia, including essays, interviews, podcasts, images and historical research.

item.title: ᓇᖕᒥᓂᖅᐳᑦ ᐃᓄᐃᑦ TV | Authentic Inuit TV
item.description: Uvagut TV (meaning “Our” TV) is Canada’s first 24/7 Inuktut television channel. Uvagut TV broadcasts children’s shows, movies, documentaries, cultural and current affairs programming in Inuktut to communities across the north and throughout the country.

item.title: Tunnganarniq Nunagijavut
item.description: Tunnganariq Nunagijavut (Welcome to Where We Live Now) is a weekly, live cultural and current affairs series produced in-house by Uvagut TV with community partners throughout Inuit Nunangat.

item.title: Qanuq Taima
item.description: Co-Director Zacharias Kunuk writes, “First day we all leave – five boats from Ham Bay. And right away the boat, that we later lost, started to have a motor problems. But at the end of the first day we were going through the straits with moving ice, but we all camped that first night near the cabin on the island. Next day was rain, so we just camped, all five boats.
